topics.title: llama.cpp adds a GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host RAM
topics.why: New --moe-cache-mib flag keeps hot experts on the GPU in an LRU cache and only uploads misses. PR numbers on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q4_0 show an RTX 5090 going from 30.8 to 67.8 tok/s generation (2.2x) with -cmoe --moe-cache-mib 19000. Landed in b11480.

topics.title: LiquidAI d1-3B and d1-omni-600M decision models land in llama.cpp
topics.why: Small multimodal decision models (state + typed questions, zero output tokens) with official GGUFs; d1-3B claims best-under-10B on the Decision Index. LFM1.0 license, not Apache.

topics.title: Ollama v0.40.1
topics.why: Windows fixes (Clef head reads past 2GiB, manifests without symlinks) and MLX residency patch now upstream.

topics.title: SpaceX SDA T1TL-A slips to NET Oct 10
topics.why: Falcon 9 and payload healthy; extra time for vehicle double checks and range deconfliction.

topics.title: Crew-12 splashes down today off California
topics.why: Dragon Freedom undocked Oct 7; NASA targets splashdown ~10:34am CT Oct 8.

topics.title: Grok Bot will route to the best backend model per task
topics.why: Musk says Grok Bot will use Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney, Suno and other APIs where they win, with a fast Grok 4.8 for simple requests once it ships. Grok Bot 0.68.1 also shipped Oct 7.
